text:
olivia: Heads-up: nightly started failing for edge SDK tests in both vitest and jest. Failures look like module identity issues with ESM/CJS mocks (fetch + kv).

ci-bot: nightly-edge-tests · build/edge-tests #501 failed 
```
Error: Cannot use import statement outside a module
    at Object.compileFunction (node:vm:360:18)
    at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader:1092:27)
```

sam: Repro: `pnpm -w test --filter @redwood/sdk -- run edge`. Vitest tries to resolve the import entry (dist/runtime.mjs) while some jest configs still hit the cjs export so the mocks attach to a different module identity.

noah: We ship conditional exports in package.json: {"./runtime": {"import":"./dist/runtime.mjs","require":"./dist/runtime.cjs"}} — that mismatch is the root cause. Vitest inline/deps behaviour differs from jest's transformIgnorePatterns.

esma: Quick local fixes that worked for CI:
1) vitest.config.ts:
```ts
export default defineConfig({
  test: {
    deps: { inline: ['@redwood/sdk'] },
    transformMode: { web: [/\.m?[jt]s$/] }
  }
})
```
2) jest.config.js:
```js
module.exports = {
  transformIgnorePatterns: ['node_modules/(?!@redwood/sdk)'],
  moduleNameMapper: { '^@redwood/sdk$': '<rootDir>/dist/runtime.cjs' }
}
```
Alternative: tiny test shim (tests/setup/require-shim.cjs) that uses createRequire to load the CJS runtime so both runners get the same identity:
```js
const { createRequire } = require('module');
const req = createRequire(import.meta.url || __filename);
module.exports = req('../dist/runtime.cjs');
```

olivia: Nice. Which option is least risky for CI?

esma: Inline deps + the require-shim is least invasive. It avoids changing distributed package.json and works across runners. We added this to the mono-repo test job and CI green on linux/mac. Windows still had path quirks but much less frequent.

sam: I'll open a PR with the shim + vitest inline config and a short note in devex about ESM/CJS pitfalls for test runners.

noah: Also add a snippet recommending `deps.inline` for vitest and moduleNameMapper approach for jest. Saves future debugging.

olivia: Thanks folks. Pushed the CI patch to the edge pipeline and scheduled a rerun. Reopen if it comes back. :white_check_mark:
